visible.n2-recipe: Easy banana bread Easy banana bread This banana bread takes ten minutes to prepare and an hour in the oven. Use three very ripe bananas, two eggs, melted butter, sugar, flour and a teaspoon of baking soda. Mash the bananas, mix in the wet ingredients, fold in the flour and bake at 175 C until a skewer comes out clean. It keeps for three days in a tin and freezes well.
